column1: How do I create an account on Alkemio?
column2: Click the sign-up link, accept the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy, and connect via LinkedIn, Microsoft, GitHub, or email.

column1: How do I find a Space on Alkemio?
column2: Click the menu button next to your profile picture, select "Explore Spaces", and use the search bar or filters.

column1: What are the first steps I should take after signing up?
column2: Fill out your profile, learn about the platform structure, join a Space, and introduce yourself in the Welcome Space.

column1: How do I create my own Space on Alkemio?
column2: Go to your profile, click the gear icon, navigate to the Account tab, and click "+" in the Hosted Spaces box.

column1: What is the difference between a Space and a Subspace on Alkemio?
column2: A Space is the main collaboration environment; a Subspace is a focused area within a Space for a specific topic or project.

column1: What is a profile on Alkemio and how do I set it up?
column2: A profile is your personal page showing your skills and contributions; set it up by adding your photo, bio, skills, and interests.

column1: How do I create a Subspace within my Space?
column2: Go to the Topics section and click "+ Create Subspace".

column1: What is a Virtual Contributor and how does it work?
column2: An AI agent trained on knowledge you provide, which you interact with by tagging it in a post.

column1: How do I add a Virtual Contributor to my Space?
column2: Go to the Community section and use "Invite Virtual Contributor".

column1: What is the Innovation Flow feature?
column2: A feature that guides members through structured phases of an innovation process within a Subspace.

column1: How do I use the whiteboard feature in Alkemio?
column2: Add a whiteboard as additional content to a Post for real-time visual collaboration.

column1: Can I embed external content using iFrames in Alkemio?
column2: Yes, using an iFrame in a Post — only whitelisted sites are supported.

column1: How do Video Calls work within Alkemio?
column2: Alkemio uses Jitsi as its built-in video conferencing tool, accessible via the video icon in your Space or Subspace.

column1: What are Templates and how can I use them in my Space?
column2: Pre-built structures for posts, whiteboards, and workflows that standardize collaboration and save time.

column1: How do I create and manage Events in my Space?
column2: Only admins can create events by clicking "+" in the Events block and filling in the details.

column1: What are Posts and how do I make them look visually appealing?
column2: Posts are the main way to share content; make them appealing using text formatting, headers, images, and embedded media.

column1: How do I use the Search feature to find content or people?
column2: Enter a keyword in the search bar to find content or people within a Space or across the entire platform.

column1: What are Updates and how do I send them to my community?
column2: Broadcast messages to all Space members; sent by admins or leads via Settings > "Updates from the leads".

column1: How do I invite people to join my Space?
column2: Go to the Community section and use "Invite people to this Space".

column1: How do I manage join requests for my Space?
column2: Approve or decline requests in the Community or Settings section of the Space.

column1: How can I activate and engage my community on Alkemio?
column2: Post regular updates, create Subspaces around relevant topics, host events, and invite Virtual Contributors.

column1: What tools does Alkemio provide for multi-stakeholder collaboration?
column2: Whiteboards, posts, memos, innovation flows, events, video calls, virtual contributors, templates, knowledge base, and updates.

column1: What are the different roles that can be assigned and what do they mean?
column2: Admin (manages settings and membership), Lead (guides community and posts updates), Member (participates in collaboration).

column1: How can I train my own Virtual Contributor?
column2: Create a VC based on a Subspace, a custom knowledge base (Word, PDF, Excel), or by linking an external AI engine.

column1: What kinds of questions or tasks can a Virtual Contributor help with?
column2: Answering questions, summarizing content, exploring ideas, and giving feedback — based on its training knowledge.

column1: How can Alkemio help with aligning a consortium?
column2: By providing a shared Space where members can collaborate, share updates, align on goals, and track progress.

column1: Can Alkemio be used to build an innovation hub?
column2: Yes, through structured Spaces, guided innovation flows, community tools, and virtual contributors.

column1: How does Alkemio support guiding a cohort or coordinating a movement?
column2: Through Spaces and Subspaces to organize activities, share resources, and keep participants aligned via updates and events.

column1: Is Alkemio suitable for universities, businesses, and cities?
column2: Yes, it is designed for any context requiring multi-stakeholder collaboration around shared goals.

column1: What is the Alkemio Foundation and what is its mission?
column2: A foundation based in The Hague that acts as purpose guarantor of the Alkemio platform, supporting changemakers in collective action.

column1: What does it mean that Alkemio is steward-owned?
column2: The company is governed to stay true to its mission, with control remaining with those committed to the purpose rather than profit.

column1: Is Alkemio open source?
column2: Alkemio is Open Source - all its code is licensed under EUPL v1.2. Only operational artifacts are closed source - IaC etc.

column1: How does Alkemio put the public interest first?
column2: Through steward-ownership, not selling user data, being open source, and focusing on societal collaboration over profit.

column1: What does "Public Interest Technology" mean in the context of Alkemio?
column2: Technology built and governed with society's needs first, rather than shareholder profits.

column1: Is Alkemio a European technology company?
column2: Yes, based in the Netherlands with AI services hosted in Sweden, EU.

column1: What platform promises does Alkemio make to its users?
column2: Not selling user data, being open source, giving each Space control over its data, and governing in the public interest.

column1: How can I contact Alkemio support?
column2: support@alkem.io

column1: Where can I find tutorials for using Alkemio?
column2: In the "How to…" section of the Alkemio documentation.
